name: TTS-Coriolis Mass Flow Meter (Series 500)
description: The TTS-Coriolis Series 500 represents the pinnacle of liquid and gas measurement instrumentation. Delivering direct mass flow, density, and temperature readings with an outstanding base accuracy of ±0.05%, this meter is designed to meet the strict standards required for custody transfer, chemical blending, and process monitoring across high-value liquid applications.
features: Direct mass flow, density, and temperature measurement
Accuracy up to ±0.05% for liquids and ±0.35% for gases
No moving parts resulting in zero physical wear-and-tear
HART, Modbus, and EtherNet/IP protocol communication
NEMA 4X / IP67 robust enclosure for harsh environments

reviews.author: Dr. Jean-Pierre
reviews.text: Highly accurate and very reliable for our chemical batching systems. The digital interface setup via Modbus was extremely smooth.

reviews.author: Alan K.
reviews.text: Excellent meter, though calibration verification took a bit of learning for our team. Support was helpful.

name: ErgoControl Industrial Console System (V-Type)
description: The ErgoControl V-Type Console is engineered to optimize operator productivity, fatigue recovery, and situational awareness in 24/7 mission-critical operations. Featuring a motorized sit-to-stand lifting mechanism, integrated dynamic cable routing, and customizable multi-monitor mounting options, it delivers an ergonomic work environment tailored to control rooms.
features: V-Type configuration ideal for collaborative multi-operator setups
Integrated smart power distribution and passive air circulation vents
Premium, chemical-resistant HPL desktop finish with soft polyurethane edges
Full compliance with ISO 11064 ergonomic standards

reviews.author: Marcus Aurelius Group
reviews.text: We outfitted our main power plant operations center with 12 of these. The sit-stand function has dramatically improved operator alertness.

name: Mitsubishi FR-E800 Variable Frequency Drive
description: The Mitsubishi FR-E800 series VFD offers exceptional motor control and energy-saving performance. Built for smart factories, it integrates advanced predictive maintenance functions and dual-port Ethernet capabilities. It provides vector control, auto-tuning, and robust safety protocols (SIL2/SIL3) out of the box, making it highly versatile for pumps, fans, conveyors, and generic industrial machinery.
features: Dual-port Ethernet communication (CC-Link IE TSN, Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP)
Corrosive gas detection and environmental warning alerts
Sensorless vector control and advanced auto-tuning algorithms
Compact size with side-by-side mounting capability

reviews.author: Steve L.
reviews.text: Solid VFD, compact and easy to mount. The built-in AI maintenance diagnosis actually saved us from a fan failure last week.

reviews.author: G. Reynolds
reviews.text: Good performance. The configuration software is a bit complex for beginners, but extremely powerful.
